Actor Charlie Sheen tells his craziest Hollywood stories to Tucker Carlson and explains why he rejects the official story of 9/11. Sheen, once TV's highest-paid star, lived a public meltdown before a quieter recovery. The bad boy holds court here in full, winning form.

Sheen recounts the wild years, the famous rants, and the cost of that fame. He lays out the questions that made him doubt the official account of the attacks. Carlson, a friend, draws out both the comedy and the candor. Amused and nostalgic viewers get a survivor of celebrity telling it his way.
